text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
She must have laughed when she heard
people say this was no place
for a queen.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Dark hair blowing in the wind, she danced
into the lead as if it were a
game. All
anyone could do was bow before her
majesty.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: This queen's name was Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
She turned everyone's dream into her own
glory. And her eyes shone
with the light of
a future which no one had ever seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The season passes into autumn, finally
bringing the day of the
Solefall Faire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The exhibit I prepared with Winning Ticket
becomes a big hit at the
event.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! Check out this
Derby—it was so moving! Right,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay. Just show it to us nice and
slow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You did well to make such a fine exhibit
while also training for your
races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was sooo busy. But my trainer helped,
and we got through it
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah! I haven't introduced anybody
yet!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This is my trainer!
And this is Taishin and
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide.
Classmates of Winning Ticket's,
they all
made their debuts around the same time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hi. So...
you must have your hands full with
her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I can imagine babysitting Ticket is
quite the challenge. To think, she even
roped you into assisting with the
exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come ooon! Is that what you two really
think of me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You've got it backwards! Trainer came to
help me with the exhibit
first!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Two people preparing a Derby exhibit team up to win the Derby—that's gotta be fate. FATE!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and speaking of fate, that reminds me!
You remember the
promise we made when
we first met, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The one we made in our first training
class?

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone, to begin with, we're
going to time your runs. I'd
like you all to
pick a distance that suits your aptitude,
and measure your times.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh,
Instructor! Can I run 2,400 meters,
just like the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Uh, yeah... It's up to you.
But new students
usually start with about
half that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I know! But my goal's the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Um, all right then... I'll ask just in
case—does anyone else want to run
2,400
meters?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Me...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I would like to run 2,400 meters as well.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: Really?! Are you all serious?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze... I-I can't do iiit! My time is way too slow!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
2,400 meters...
Running a classics distance
is no simple task.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
You should work on mastering some basics
first and improve to the
point where you
can run the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff... U-understood...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll do it one day...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will master this distance...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ehehe! Hey, you two! Thanks for
running with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do it for you, so don't thank me.
That's just the distance I aim
to run
someday.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's simply a distance one must be
competent in to become a great
racer.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! You're both going for the Derby
too! Three students in the
same class with
eyes on the same goal...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh! What a story!
Let's all race in the
Derby togetheeer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ack! Wait... Why're you crying?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Our race'll be one for the history books!
The most heated, dramatic
Derby ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ticket's eyes shine brightly as she
recounts
the tale of how they took
the first step
toward their dreams together.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaall right! Let's make that promise one
more time! All together now!
One, two...
DEEERBYYY!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? You didn't say it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The curator of this exhibit is starting to
annoy me. Let's go somewhere
else.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe there's entertainment on the
outdoor stage.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
We're just kidding. But really, I need to
get to training soon.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Training? Right in the middle of the
Solefall Faire?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin's running in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! You know I'll be there rooting
for ya, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's training for her race even during a
school event...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to Narita Taishin's gruff
exterior,
she's actually quite
disciplined.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go one more time to get in the
spirit! One, two...
DEEERBYYY!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I told you, that's annoying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're around the fourth corner and
Narita Taishin is in second! But
wait! The
other racers are close behind!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishiiin! Go! YOU CAN DO IT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ticket's fervent cheers prove futile, and
Taishin places sixth.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
D-don't worry about it!
We'll train for the
next one together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but don't bother trying to cheer me
up. I wanna be alone right
now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh... Uh, sorry...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Three good friends all aim to win the
Derby. But this race serves as a bitter
reminder that the path to achieving such a
dream is a bumpy
one.
